report.answer_text:
Arizona's spring training league is the Cactus League. It has 15 MLB teams:
Arizona Diamondbacks
Athletics
Chicago Cubs
Chicago White Sox
Cincinnati Reds
Cleveland Guardians
Colorado Rockies
Kansas City Royals
Los Angeles Angels
Los Angeles Dodgers
Milwaukee Brewers
San Diego Padres
San Francisco Giants
Seattle Mariners
Texas Rangers
Most teams train in the Phoenix area, in cities such as Scottsdale, Mesa, Glendale, Goodyear, Peoria, Surprise and Tempe. The Rockies and Diamondbacks share Salt River Fields at Talking Stick in Scottsdale. The other 15 MLB teams train in Florida's Grapefruit League.
I'm going from memory, so check the official Cactus League schedule for the current season. The Athletics' situation in particular has changed in recent years as the team has moved.
